oral_examination.oral_examination: 14 15 Mesio-distal proximal hole, probe and tap, no loose teeth, no red or swollen gums

treatment_plan.notes: Ask for follow-up consultation if you feel unwell. Bite a cotton roll for 40 minutes. Do not brush your teeth or rinse your mouth for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine was performed. The marrow was not fully exposed due to the removal of the succumb, and there was a large amount of bleeding. The medullary hole was enlarged, the roof was uncovered, and 2 canals were explored. The marrow was extracted and shaped. There was a small amount of bleeding. The root canals were dredged to 15 with a hand file.
